messages.author: 74bb2243bb8c3b1b
messages.subject: write cross2
parts:
Hi 

I have converted my cross to cross2 with convert2cross2(). But how can I write this cross2 for qtl2 so that I can write qtl2cl?

Best,
Taslima

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] write cross2
parts:
I don't yet have a way to write out the data for R/qtl2.

And I wouldn't recommend using qtl2cl at this point; that's being explored as a way to make an command-line-based "API" for R/qtl2, particularly for GeneNetwork2 (http://gn2.genenetwork.org/).

But the first step in using qtl2cl (--cross2rds) is to read in the data and then save it as an RDS file, and all subsequent commands use the RDS file, so you could save your cross2 object as RDS with saveRDS() and then do all the rest with qtl2cl, if you want.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] write cross2
parts:
I would do it directly within R, with qtl2geno::calc_kinship().

library(qtl2geno)
iron <- read_cross2(system.file("extdata", "iron.zip", package="qtl2geno"))
map <- insert_pseudomarkers(iron$gmap, step=1)
pr <- calc_genoprob(iron, map)
k <- calc_kinship(pr)

karl
